items.reasons: The torii is drawn as a flat front elevation. The kasagi and nuki beams show no lit top planes and the pillars have no depth, unlike the originals, which all show a 3+ row top surface. The red and grey parts don't use the chipset's consistent dark navy outline, and at 2x the thin gate (about 2 tiles wide) looks undersized and pasted onto the room floor. The grey base blocks barely work as a ground line.

The gantry top is a lit plane with the display panel, the bore ring sits on a short front face, and the patient table runs forward and is seen from above. The thick dark outline and the white/grey palette with blue accents match the counter and desk originals. It reads clearly as an MRI at 1x and sits on the floor in the room without hovering.
